title: Agreement with py-polars
description: Each case runs the same operation in phpolars and in py-polars 1.43.2 on the same input, from scripts/pyfixtures.py and tests/pyfixtures.php. A case passes when the column names, the data types, and every value agree. Integers, strings, booleans, dates, and nulls must be equal; floats may differ by the relative tolerance. Cases that expect an error pass when phpolars raises the same exception class. n_compared counts the values compared, and the errors are over numeric values.
